name: Stroke-based splatting
definition: A point cloud visualization technique that applies concepts of stroke-based rendering to surface-aligned splatting, shaping each object-aligned splat as a brush stroke and orienting it according to globally coherent tangent vectors to create a painterly depiction of the scanned cloud.
summary: Stroke-based splatting renders point clouds as brush strokes in 3D space to avoid pixelized artifacts and improve shape perception, unlike 2D image-space methods.
